title: [review] local-fact: no freshness (expiry/seq/epoch) — revocation impossible while key trusted
description: Security finding on viku.4. The credential carries no expiry, seq, or epoch; 'mesh-lifetime' invalidation is purely infrastructural (gateway restart / root re-election). A gateway cannot revoke or supersede an issued fact while its key remains trusted — a withdrawn grant (e.g. relay=true revoked for abuse) remains verifiable indefinitely. Sibling delegation_tokens carries expiry + seq with EXPIRED/REPLAY_DETECTED. Consider adding expiry/seq or an epoch claim; may need spec 8.13.1 amendment.
close_reason: Added optional lichen:expiry/lichen:seq freshness claims to the local-fact credential (python/src/lichen/gateway/local_facts.py), mirroring delegation_tokens/capability_announcements. Claims validated (exact-type, expiry>0, seq>=0); verify_local_fact now enforces fail-closed expiry/seq checks (current_time/cached_seq params) with a documented cached_seq=-1 first-contact bootstrap and cache-update-only-after-verify invariant. Amended spec 8.13.1 (claim table + Freshness-and-Revocation + Validity). 52 tests pass; ruff/mypy no-new-errors (residual SIM102:260 + attr-defined pre-existing at HEAD). 3x codereview delegated to kimi-k3: correctness PASS; security 3 findings (bootstrap gap + cache invariant fixed in-diff; issuer-seq-restart filed as xeli); edge 2 findings (bootstrap dup; test comment fixed in-diff). Convergence re-review PASS.
